title: nOSS server config
description: A server's settings: the dedicated server's --config file, and what a listen server's host sets in the menu. See docs/NETWORKING.md §9.

whitelist.description: If not empty, only these fingerprints may join.

upnp.description: Ask the router to open the port.

state_rate.description: Car states per second sent by clients; 0 = 60 on fast links, else 30.

countdown_s.description: Seconds from everyone ready to the start.

classes.description: Classes players may pick; empty = every class of the event's mode.

assists.description: Assists players may use, narrowing the platform's and mode's; omitted = what they allow.

tuning.description: Setups: allowed where the platform and mode allow them, or locked.

fitting.description: strict: physics uses the platform's reference geometry (docs/PLATFORMS.md §4.2).

hotswap.description: Car swaps: outside races, never, or always.

ghost_bad_links.description: Ghost a car whose link is bad (RTT over 250 ms or loss over 5%).

max_track_mb.description: Largest track this server sends; a bigger one gives way to the Proving Ground.

own_sounds.description: Own engine recordings; tuned built-in sounds always play.

plausibility.description: What a failed plausibility check does.

track.description: A track's id (built-in, like proving_ground, or in the track library) or a path (.nosstrack, track folder or track.json), relative to the config; endless events need none (their road comes from road_seed).

name.description: What the playlist calls it ("Regular race"); made from the event when missing.

cup.description: A kart cup's race (its races run in turn, the server keeping the standings): the cup's id and name, this race's index and how many there are.

kind.description: time_trial: a timed session of hot laps, ghosted (tt_min); battle: a kart class on an arena (D144); endless: a road made from road_seed (D159); sumo: shrinking platforms made from the sumo_* settings (D162); drag: a strip made from the drag_* settings (D168).

tt_min.description: Time trials: the session's minutes (0: no end).

ai_count.description: AI cars; online, fewer if the grid would pass 16 cars.

start.description: track: what the track suggests (its rules, D207).

draft.description: Track events: drafting (track: what the track suggests, D207, D208).

fuel_x.description: Track events: fuel use, times the car's own (-1: the track's; 0: none, D209).

tyre_x.description: Track events: tire wear, times the car's own (-1: the track's; 0: none, D209).

plate.description: Track events: a restrictor plate (track: what the track suggests, D226).

police.description: Highway and endless events: the police.

traffic.description: Highway events: traffic cars (-1: the track's own count).

run.description: Highway events: the run's id ("": the first).

direction.description: Highway events: the way players start (0: both ways, turn about).

battle_rule.description: Battles: last one standing or most hits.

battle_hits.description: Most-hits battles: the first to this many wins (0: the most when time's up).

sumo_tiers.description: Sumo: platforms stacked, each wider than the one above.

sumo_hazard.description: Sumo: what is under the platforms.

sumo_shrink.description: Sumo: how a platform shrinks away.

sumo_secs.description: Sumo: how long one platform takes to shrink away.

sumo_pillar.description: Sumo: sudden death, the bottom platform holds at a pillar.

sumo_drift.description: Sumo: how much of the kart drift the cars get.

drag_length_m.description: Drag: the start line to the lights (1/8, 1/4 or 1/2 mile).

drag_timing.description: Drag: shifts are timed against the tach.

drag_qtes.description: Drag: the burnout, the two-step and the shake fire at all.

drag_tree.description: Drag: the Christmas tree, with reaction times and red lights.

drag_two_step.description: Drag: hold the revs in the band on the line.

drag_burnout.description: Drag: the water box before the pass.

drag_shake.description: Drag: a spinning launch opens a moment to feather it.

drag_chain.description: Drag: perfect shifts in a row build the surge.

drag_money_shift.description: Drag: over-revving loses power, and in the end the engine.

drag_centreline.description: Drag: crossing the centreline loses the pass.

time.description: Time of day (track: the track's own fixed sun).

time_rate.description: Game minutes per real minute (0: the time stands still).

weather.description: Weather (track: the track's own; changing: fronts come and go).

env_seed.description: Seed of the weather's fronts (0: picked when the session starts).

biome.description: Endless events: the biome the road starts in (NossRoadGen.biome_ids order).

spread.description: Endless events: local players far apart on one game: bring the one behind up, or hold the leader back.

lanes.description: Endless events: the road's lanes, one or two each way.

drive_side.description: Endless events: the side traffic keeps to.

garage_traffic.description: Endless events: the server's garage cars drive in the traffic, shared with everyone.

speed_traps.description: Endless events: speed cameras and parked patrols.
